userStories.description: Replace per-principal local rollback as the authority for mixed ranked with canonical season/ruleset stream recomputation, because one exclusion changes later opponents' priors.
acceptanceCriteria: 0075 follows 0074 linearly and adds season game exclusions/recompute runs/checkpoints/audit; existing per-principal exclusions remain legacy-compatible.
Pure recompute orders included game input records by terminal timestamp plus game id, replays every human prior/event from season initial state, and returns byte-identical ratings/events/checkpoints.
Excluding one game recomputes every transitively affected human in the season/ruleset/mode; game events/hash chains and AI anchor snapshots remain untouched.
Admin operation is idempotent, resumable, dry-run diffable, actor/reason audited, and atomically publishes a completed version so readers never see partial ladder.
Golden test compares recompute after exclusion to a fresh season that never contained the game, including forfeits/withdrawn/deleted principals.
userStories.notes: Critical correctness for multiplayer ratings.

userStories.title: Season-scoped solo and mixed leaderboards
userStories.description: Expose separate season/ruleset/mode human leaderboards with pseudonymous handles, provisional/decay state, role/faction diagnostics, recompute version, and privacy-safe pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: API requires explicit mode/season/ruleset or selects current active deterministically; solo and mixed rows never intermix.
Headline rank uses the scoped rating with provisional exclusion/read-side decay; diagnostics show sample counts/outcomes by role/faction but no role-specific rank below privacy/sample threshold.
Withdrawn/banned/quarantined/deleted handling follows existing consent/GDPR policy and recompute publication atomically invalidates cache.
Responses expose no display_name/email/raw UUID/IP/device/report/ban evidence; handle policy remains authoritative.
Frontend presents season switcher, solo/mixed tabs, methodology, provisional progress, and empty/frozen/closed states.
userStories.notes: Scientific model leaderboards remain separate navigation/product.

userStories.title: Mixed ranked queue, ready check, and post-match UI
userStories.description: Complete the player journey for Ranked Mixed: eligibility, season disclosure, queue, wait/cancel, ready check, anonymous game, safety controls, and scoped rating result.
acceptanceCriteria: Ranked mode screen distinguishes Solo vs Mixed, expected wait/human minimum/AI backfill, season/rules, no parties/model choice, forfeit/safety policy, and rating scope.
Queue survives refresh/reconnect via SSE, widens bands transparently without exposing hidden candidates, and supports fair cancel/ready transitions.
Ready check is accessible and time-bounded; decline/no-show/cooldown/no-contest explanations match server reason tokens.
Live table remains identity-blind and uses existing atmospheric UI; report/block/mute controls follow US-399.
Post-match shows mixed delta/team expectation/role context/provisional rank and links season methodology without exposing others' ratings pregame.
userStories.notes: Frontend gates mandatory.

userStories.title: Ranked mixed deterministic end-to-end games
userStories.description: Add multi-browser default-suite tests for ranked mixed tables with real queue/ticket/readiness APIs, AI backfill, human actions/chat, terminal rating, safety, and replay.
acceptanceCriteria: At least four verified humans enter separately, ready, are assigned across a mini7 table with AI backfill, play to terminal, and each receives exactly one MIXED scoped event.
A second scenario covers block incompatibility, one no-show replacement/return, one midgame takeover forfeit, report/mute, and eligible players' coherent ratings.
Requests cannot set model/role/team/routing/funding/invite; pre-reveal responses remain identity-blind and scientific tables stay untouched.
Worker/API restart during queue and game converges without duplicate ticket/game/rating/charge; replay and season recompute match live result.
Desktop and mobile Playwright drive representative humans while deterministic mocks drive others; no real provider call.
userStories.notes: Mixed ranked release candidate gate.

userStories.title: Shadow calibration and go/no-go report
userStories.description: Run both ranked modes in SHADOW over deterministic simulations and operator-approved test games, producing a machine-readable go/no-go report instead of enabling flags on code completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Report covers eligibility/refusal rates, queue waits/backfill/human mix, role/faction exposure, prediction calibration, rating inflation/convergence, provider reliability/cost, forfeits/no-contests, moderation/flag rates, and privacy/firewall audits.
Thresholds are versioned settings/policy; below-threshold results name blocking metrics and cannot transition season to ACTIVE.
Shadow games write audit/simulated candidate outputs but no public ratings/leaderboard ranks; scientific and casual stats remain distinguishable.
Report is deterministic for same dataset/config and includes catalog/pool/calibration/code version hashes.
Tests construct pass/fail fixtures for every hard threshold and prove flags remain default off.
userStories.notes: Human operator reviews report before activation.

userStories.title: Ranked capacity, concurrency, and abuse load gate
userStories.description: Prove the separate human lane and DB-as-queue survive realistic ranked concurrency, SSE reconnects, rating serialization, OpenRouter failures, and adversarial admission without starving scientific work.
acceptanceCriteria: Load harness covers configured concurrent solo/mixed queues/games, multiple API/worker processes, Postgres claims, SSE reconnect storms, chat/action rate limits, and terminal rating settlement.
No duplicate/overbooked ticket, game, seat, schedule cell, rating event, ledger charge, or recompute publication occurs under races.
Human ranked load does not consume benchmark scheduler semaphore/capacity; scientific heartbeat/game progress remains within threshold.
Provider latency/429/5xx, catalog stale, credential unavailable, flag flip, and DB worker restart degrade to bounded queue/no-contest behavior.
Metrics/alerts expose queue age, ready failures, no-contests, rating lag, recompute lag, provider/cost drift, safety backlog, and firewall violations with low-cardinality labels.
userStories.notes: Postgres test can remain marked postgres but default pure/concurrency model must run.

userStories.title: Wave 16 canary flags, runbooks, and final release gate
userStories.description: Finalize one operator-controlled activation sequence for scientific OpenRouter, ranked solo, then ranked mixed. Implementation completion leaves all production switches off.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings and deployment examples keep global, solo, and mixed human rating/match flags False by default; scientific OpenRouter recruitment is independently gated.

Runbook/checklist covers catalog/probe/pool freeze, key/credential encryption readiness, budgets/completion reserve, legal/consent, shadow report, migrations/backups, rollback/recompute, moderation staffing, canary cohort, metrics/alerts, and emergency kill.
Automated audit proves custom games cannot rate; solo/mixed cannot accept player config; human hot paths touch zero scientific ratings; credentials never leak; season/rating/recompute hashes verify.
End-to-end release suite includes AI-only scientific OpenRouter, ranked solo, ranked mixed, flag-off in-flight refusal/no-contest, and rollback/recompute without event-chain mutation.
Only an explicit operator action may transition a validated SHADOW season ACTIVE and enable its flag; code/tests never flip production configuration.
userStories.notes: Final story in the combined Ralph queue.
